remarks: Take advantage of this incredible opportunity to sublease an acquire a well-established, fully equipped hair salon in a prime Norwalk, CT location! Recently renovated within the last five years this modern salon features state of the art equipment, including 8 styling chairs and 3 sinks,providing the perfect setup for beauty professionals looking to grow their business.   The owner is asking $35,00 in key money, plus the sublease rental at $3,100 a month through October 31, 2025. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to take over a stylish, fully operational salon in a thriving location!
